implementation.admission: Closed dedicated controller invocation and bounded existing lifecycle lease; retry only sharing/lock violations before child startup.
implementation.cleanup: Whole-command deadline, armed owned Jobs, separate consumed-holder state, per-project listener verification, no global empty-process guard during peer serving.
implementation.legacy: Existing unscoped run path and protected release guards remain unchanged.
implementation.configuration: Reuse approved development configuration; typed read-only preflight refuses identity initialization or route migration before child launch.
implementation.registry: Existing project registry and paired Wake target; no competing registry, arbitrary execution root or native writer assignment.
implementation.pins: Acquire canonical and selected-release pins under the lease, revalidate after pinning, retain read-only deny-write/delete handles during serving. No registry or task lease held during serving.
implementation.handoff: Authenticate and verify child scope, release/reap lease holder exactly once, then publish READY. A peer may start while the first serves.

qualification.note: The original backend filter selected legacy tests only. A supplemental run selected only the eight new project-module tests. Its first harness parse failed before tests started; corrected harness and both histories are retained.

limits: Current known slot-b generation-2 stopped release only; source-qualified controller must be built separately.
Read-only local project operation is not authenticated ChatGPT Web coding, project-write ownership or unattended serving.
No new installed artifact, promotion, different-version rollback or external connector acceptance.
Connector HTTP 429 not retried; live independent operator controllers remain the next qualification.
